title: Unique descent of an exact-functor tensor comparison
statement: Let C,D be Grothendieck abelian braided closed monoidal categories with the derived tensor of [def-weil-derived-tensor] and functorial flat resolutions. Let G,F₁,F₂:C→D be additive exact functors, with F₂ preserving flat objects and being a left adjoint. A natural tensor comparison on cochain complexes τ:G(P⊗Q)→F₁(P)⊗F₂(Q) induces a unique family t:DG(M⊗N)→DF₁(M)⊗DF₂(N), natural in both variables and compatible with τ on every pair of cochain representatives and the tensor-localization counits. The normalization retains the canonical identification of the monoidal complex tensor with the signed total tensor. Also a coefficient tensor comparison extends uniquely to signed total complexes with the prescribed map on every bidegree summand.

source.place: Signed total tensor and K-flat derivation of the supported exterior product

proof.text: Extend a natural coefficient comparison to complexes by mapBifunctorComparison. Its summand formula is map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX. Uniqueness follows degreewise from mapBifunctor.hom_ext_of_map and preservation of the requisite coproducts.

Use functorial flat resolutions in the second variable. F₂ preserves flat objects and colimits, so the image resolution is K-flat. The mixed tensor bifunctor on derived categories is a left derived bifunctor, with counit the two mapDerivedCategoryFactors followed by the tensor-localization counit. The latter is invertible when its second complex is K-flat.

Apply leftDerived₂Lift to the composite of the source tensor-localization counit, the exact functor comparison of G, and τ. The resulting natural transformation supplies t. Its factorization equation is precisely the model normalization. Conversely a natural family yields a transformation; leftDerived₂_ext and that equation prove uniqueness. Use tensorHom_def to match curried tensor maps, and explicitly prove that the retained tensor-model identity maps to an identity.

proof_origin.place: Closed-support flatness and universal K-flat descent; all Lean proofs completed

    [F₂.PreservesFlat] [F₂.IsLeftAdjoint]
    (τ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).obj
        (curriedTensor (CochainComplex C ℤ)) ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj (F₁.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).obj
        (F₂.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ))).obj (curriedTensor _)) :
    ∃! t : ComparisonHom G F₁ F₂,
      ComparisonCondition G F₁ F₂ τ t
